steps.text: The box itself stays fixed; the red button slides inward when contacted. My first pushes moved it only about 2–3 cm, short of the press range. I’ll try sustained contact at button height with the gripper closed, then adjust the contact height or lateral alignment if it still stalls.

python - <<'PY'
from mw_runtime import Session
s=Session();s.move([-0.05,0.40,0.52],gripper=-1,steps=45);s.move([-0.048,0.74,0.45],gripper=-1,steps=45);s.move([-0.04835,0.74,0.11508],gripper=-1,steps=50)
print('touch',s.observe()['tcp'],s.observe()['bodies']['button']['position'])
# close gripper then push straight forward by repeated maximal increments
for j in range(4):
 for i in range(20): s.step([0,1,0,1])
 o=s.observe(); r=s.result(); print(j,o['tcp'],o['bodies']['button']['position'],r['success'],r['info'])
 if r['success']: break
from PIL import Image
Image.fromarray(s.render()).save('/app/output/closedpress.png')
s.save('/app/output/trajectory.npz')
PY
